verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              कुन्त्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा भीष्मद्रोणौ महारथौ। दुर्योधनमिदं वाक्यमूचतुः शासनातिगम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words of Kunti the great carwarriors Bhishma and Drona, said these words of Duryodhana who had grown unaccustomed to obey their orders.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतं ते पुरुषव्याघ्र कुन्त्याः कृष्णस्य सन्निधौ। वाक्यमर्थवदत्युग्रमुक्तं धर्म्यमनुत्तमम् ॥२॥
verses.english: It has been heard by you, O foremost of men, what inciting words Kunti has said to Krishna, than which nothing is more excellent and which lead to virtue.

verses.sanskrit: तत् करिष्यन्ति कौन्तेया वासुदेवस्य संमतम्। न हि ते जातु शाम्येरन्नृते राज्येन कौरव ॥३॥
verses.english: The sons of Kunti will do that with the approval of Vasudeva and they will not be pacified without the kingdom, O son of Kuru.

verses.sanskrit: क्लेशिता हि त्वया पार्था धर्मपाशसितास्तदा। सभायां द्रौपदी चैव तैश्च तन्मर्षितं तव ॥४॥
verses.english: The sons of Pritha had been persecuted by you in the Assembly-hall, but being bound by the ties of virtue they over-looked all that at the time.

verses.sanskrit: कृतास्त्रं ह्यर्जुनं प्राप्य भीमं च कृतनिश्चयम्। गाण्डीवं चेषुधी चैव रथं च ध्वजमेव च ॥५॥
verses.english: Having however now obtained the master of all weapons, Arjuna, and Bhima of fast determination and the Gandiva bow and the two quivers and the chariot and flag.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलं सहदेवं च बलवीर्यसमन्वितौ। सहायं वासुदेवं च न क्षंस्यति युधिष्ठिरः ॥६॥
verses.english: And Nakula and Sahadeva, both endued with might and energy and Vasudeva as his allies, Yudhishthira will not forgive anything.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यक्षं ते महाबाहो यथा पार्थेन धीमता। विराटनगरे पूर्वं सर्वे स्म युधि निर्जिताः ॥७॥
verses.english: You are an witness, O you of long arms, how before this in the city of Virata, all of us were vanquished in battle by the wise son of Pritha.

verses.sanskrit: दानवा घोरकर्माणो निवातकवचा युधि। रौद्रमस्त्रं समादाय दग्धा वानरकेतुना ॥८॥
verses.english: Those Danavas of fierce deeds called Nivatakavachas were consumed by him, who has the emblem of monkeys on his banner, in battle with a number of fierce weapons.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णप्रभृतयश्चेमे त्वं चापि कवची रथी। मोक्षितो घोषयात्रायां पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्। प्रशाम्य भरतश्रेष्ठ भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डवैः ॥९॥
verses.english: Karna and all of your councillors and yourself clad in coats of mail and seated on a chariot were liberated (from the grasp of the Gandharvas) on your expedition against cattle which is a sufficient proof,

verses.sanskrit: रक्षेमां पृथिवीं सर्वां मृत्योर्दष्ट्रान्तरं गताम्। ज्येष्ठो भ्राता धर्मशीलो वत्सलः श्लक्ष्णवाक्कविः ॥१०॥
verses.english: O foremost among the Bharatas, make peace along with your brothers with the sons of Pandu. Save this entire earth which has come under the very jaws of death. Your elder brother is of virtuous habits of life, affectionate, sweet of speech and wise.

verses.sanskrit: तं गच्छ पुरुषव्याघ्रं व्यपनीयेह किल्बिषम्। दृष्टश्च त्वं पाण्डवेन व्यपनीतशरासनः ॥११॥
verses.english: Seek you therefore the protection of that foremost of men abandoning these sinful intentions. If by the son of Pandu, you are seen to have laid aside your bow,

verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तभ्रुकुटिः श्रीमान् कृता शान्तिः कुलस्य नः। तमभ्येत्य सहामात्यः परिष्वज्य नृपात्मजम् ॥१२॥
verses.english: And with the wrinkles of rage smoothed down, and looking happy as if endued with prosperity then will the peace of our race have been effected. Having gone to him with your ininisters and embracing that son of a ruler of men.

verses.sanskrit: अभिवादय राजानं यथापूर्वमरिन्दम। अभिवादयमानं त्वां पाणिभ्यां भीमपूर्वजः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Salute that king as you used to do before, O chastiser of foes, and let the elder brother of Bhima, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti hold you when saluting, by his two hands out of affection.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्णातु सौहार्दात् कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। सिंहस्कन्धोरुबाहुस्त्वां वृत्तायतमहाभुजः ॥१४॥
परिष्वजतु बाहुभ्यां भीमः प्रहरतां वरः। कम्बुग्रीवो गुडाकेशस्ततस्त्वां पुष्करेक्षणः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Let also that one, possessed of the shoulders of a lion and round thighs and arms and of long arms, namely Bhima, the foremost among smiters, with his arms embrace you.

verses.sanskrit: अभिवादयतां पार्थः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनञ्जयः ॥१६॥
verses.english: Let also the son of Kunti, Partha or Dhananjaya of eyes like the leaves of the lotus, with a neck like the conch and of curling hairs, also respectfully salute you.

verses.sanskrit: आश्विनेयौ नरव्याघ्रौ रुपेणाप्रतिमौ भुवि। तौ च त्वां गुरुवत्प्रेम्णा पूजया प्रत्युदीयताम् ॥१७॥
verses.english: Let the two sons of Ashvini also those foremost among men, who are of unrivaled beauty in this world-let them also offer you worship out of love, as to their elder brother.

verses.sanskrit: मुञ्चन्त्यानन्दजाश्रूणि दाशार्हप्रमुखा नृपाः। संगच्छ भ्रातृभिः सार्धं मानं संत्यज्य पार्थिव ॥१८॥
verses.english: Let also these rulers among men with the scion of the Dasharha race shed tears of joy (at the union); having abandoned your vanity, O ruler of the earth, be united with your brothers.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशाधि पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां ततस्त्वं भ्रातृभिः सह। समालिङ्ग्य च हर्षेण नृपा यान्तु परस्परम् ॥१९॥
verses.english: Rule this earth united together with your brothers and let the rulers of men return to their, kingdoms after embracing one another (in a friendly way)

verses.sanskrit: अलं युद्धेन राजेन्द्र सहृदां शृणु वारणम्। ध्रुवं विनाशो युद्धे हि क्षत्रियाणां प्रदृदयते ॥२०॥
verses.english: War is not necessary, O chief among kings; listen to the dissuasion of your well wishers; sure destruction stares the Kshatriyas in the face in case of fight.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतींषि प्रतिकूलानि दारुणा मृगपक्षिणः। उत्पाता विविधा वीर दृश्यन्ते क्षत्रनाशनाः ॥२१॥
verses.english: The stars and planets are against us; animals and birds of ill omen as also many sorts of disturbances portending the massacre of the Kshatriyas are seen.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषत इहास्माकं निमित्तानि निवेशने। उल्काभिर्हि प्रदीप्ताभिर्बाध्यते पृतना तव ॥२२॥
verses.english: Especially are these omens seen in our encampment. Burning meteors again are coming in the way of your army.

verses.sanskrit: वाहनान्यप्रहृष्टानि रुदन्तीव विशाम्पते। गृध्रास्ते पर्युपासन्ते सैन्यानि च समन्ततः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Our soldiers are cheerless and weeping as it were, O lord of the universe and vultures are constantly wheeling around our army.

verses.sanskrit: नगरं न यथापूर्वं तथा राजनिवेशनम्। शिवाश्चाशिवनिर्घोषा दीप्तां सेवन्ति वै दिशम् ॥२४॥
verses.english: The town has lost its old appearance as also the palace of the king; jackals too with constant howls are prowling about in every direction which is blazing.

verses.sanskrit: कुरु वाक्यं पितुर्मातुरस्माकं च हितैषिणाम्। त्वय्यायत्तो महाबाहो शमो व्यायाम एव च ॥२५॥
verses.english: Listen therefore to the advice of your father and of your mother as also of ourselves for we desire your wellbeing. At your discretion, O you of long arms, lies peace or war.

verses.sanskrit: न चेत्करिष्यसि वचः सुहृदामरिकर्शन। तप्स्यसे वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा पार्थबाणप्रपीडिताम् ॥२६॥
verses.english: If you do not follow the advice of your well wishers you will come to grief having seen your army afflicted by the arrows of the son of Pritha,

verses.sanskrit: भीमस्य च महानादं नदतः शुष्मिणो रणे। श्रुत्वा स्मर्तासि मे वाक्यं गाण्डीवस्य च निःस्वनम्। यद्येतदपसव्यं ते वचो मम भविष्यति ॥२७॥
verses.english: As also by the loud and frequent roars of Bhima in battle. Hearing also the twang of the Gandiva bow you will remember our words and if all this is not followed by you, what we say will come to pass.
